payout_quote: The consumer, in turn, pays the retailer 10-cents for each beverage container he or she purchases from the retailer. / The retailer or redemption center pays the consumer 10-cents for each container returned by the consumer.
steps: Buy covered beverages in Connecticut (10¢ deposit at checkout since Jan 1, 2024)
Keep empties 150ml–3L (carbonated) or 150ml–2.5L (noncarbonated) with deposit info visible
Return to a retailer (must take back brands they sell, during all operating hours) or a redemption center
catches: This returns YOUR OWN deposit money paid at purchase — it is recovering your own money, not new income.
Only containers bought in-state with the correct deposit label are redeemable; out-of-state containers are ineligible and redeeming them is fraud.
Old 5¢-labeled inventory may still circulate but you are charged and refunded 10¢ regardless of label; mini/nip bottles carry a non-refundable 5¢ fee, not a deposit.
biggest_catch: Returns your own 10¢ deposit — you paid it at purchase. This is deposit recovery, not income.
eligibility: Anyone who purchased covered beverage containers in Connecticut.

c1.evidence: Connecticut Department of Energy and Environmental Protection (DEEP) Bottle Bill FAQ; portal.ct.gov.

c2.evidence: Official DEEP FAQ: consumer pays retailer 10-cents per container; retailer/redemption center pays consumer 10-cents per container returned.

c3.evidence: No fee; deposit already paid at purchase.

c4.evidence: 10¢ per container; retailers cannot refuse same kind/size/brand during operating hours.

s1.note: Connecticut-purchased covered containers (carbonated + noncarbonated beverages incl. water, juice, sports drinks).

s6.note: Steps are concrete: buy, save, return to retailer/center, get refund.

notes: CT raised the deposit to 10¢ in 2024 and expanded coverage to nearly all beverages.
payout_value_note: Flat official 10¢ per covered container (raised from 5¢ Jan 1, 2024; PA 21-58).
numeric_basis: payout from official CT DEEP FAQ (10¢/container); time: collecting empties + return trip est. 20–60 min active.
